reason: The inspected revision has strong native-control foundations, associated application errors, explicit recovery choices, 44px primary targets and reduced-motion support. Mobile capture hierarchy is coherent with Precision Instrument. Synthetic operator coverage failures correctly disable closing and offer retry; Escape restores focus. However, contact and sign-out failure recovery remain incomplete at consequential public entry points. These source-confirmed gaps prevent my unqualified world-class agreement. This is an independent simulated AI accessibility assessment, not observed user success or a conformance audit; the hold concerns the identified recovery gaps, and fixing them would still require independent verification.

findings.evidence: submit sets sending, then awaits raw fetch and response.json without a client deadline; Send message stays disabled until either settles. The adjacent live-region message is cleared during the wait. The supplied public journey test intercepts a successful response only. The server email timeout does not bound a stalled browser-to-server request or response body.
findings.userImpact: A client using keyboard or assistive technology can remain at Sending indefinitely without an announced recovery state or a way to retry within the form. Their project inquiry has an uncertain delivery outcome.
findings.suggestedFix: Bound the full request/response operation, preserve entered values, announce that delivery could not be confirmed and expose the existing email alternative. Restore an actionable state and add a delayed/nonsettling-response regression without claiming that timeout proves non-delivery.

findings.evidence: logout closes mobile navigation through onNavigate before awaiting clerk.signOut. It has finally to clear busy but no catch, rendered error or live-region receipt when signOut rejects.
findings.userImpact: On provider/network rejection, the menu disappears and there is no accessible explanation that sign-out failed or session state is uncertain. Users may incorrectly infer completion or struggle to find the retry action.
findings.suggestedFix: Handle rejection with persistent, announced failure guidance and a reachable retry action; preserve or restore focus to that action. Test a rejected signOut promise on desktop and mobile, while treating hosted session behavior as separately unverified.

notVerified: No staging, hosted integration, real authenticated operator session, human study or assistive-technology session exists in this evidence. Clerk failure presentation and actual session termination were not executed.

No physical-device, Safari/Firefox, screen-reader announcements, high zoom/reflow or complete keyboard traversal was observed. Captures are static; the operator image is synthetic and its scrollable lower actions are not proof of reachability.
Application recovery tests use intercepted APIs; supplied 76-case and 18-case logs represent separate runs. I ran no tests or shared browser.

Public copy withholds unapproved case results and application review copy discloses original-resume identification; Board policy approval, client publication approval and actual privacy/RLS integration remain outside this review.
